text:
Marta (Product): Quick note 1 were launching a limited preview for the Hosted Failover Policy feature tomorrow at 07:30 PT. This adds automatic per-route fallback chains (model -> region -> capacity-tier) for hosted streaming endpoints. Opt-in only for partners & internal teams. Please review the preview checklist before testing. :loudspeaker:
Gabe (Eng Runtime): Route = /v2/failover. Behavior: if primary model is unavailable we try model-compat fallback, then region-fallback, then dedicated-slim. No silent retries for tool calls in this preview (explicit failure returned).
Clara (DevEx): Copy-paste curl to try (use canary key):
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v2/failover \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_CANARY" \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -d '{"model":"fast-4b","input":"Test fallback behavior","route_policy":{"fallbacks":[{"type":"model","id":"fast-3b"},{"type":"region","id":"eu-west1"}]}}'
```
Clara (DevEx): JS SDK note: use .on('fallback', info => ...) to instrument fallback events during streaming.
Deploy-Bot: [deploy] canary rollout started service=hosted-failover region=us-west1 at 2026-06-10T07:30:00Z :rocket:
Theo (SRE): Health checks added: fallback-rate metric (should be < 2% during preview) and p95 latency impact dashboard. Canary pages if 5xx > 0.35% for 4m or fallback-rate > 5% sustained 5m. Add your synthetic test hitting /v2/failover with canary key.
Quota-Bot: Preview orgs will get a per-route quota of 12 req/s steady, burst 48. File requests in #ops-requests for higher limits and include org id + test window.
Gabe (Eng Runtime): Note: tool-call wire format changed slightly for richer error annotations; if tools start failing tag me with request_id. Were keeping legacy /v1/stream intact.
Marta (Product): Internal office hours tomorrow 08:15 PT (20m) to collect early feedback and surface odd failure modes. RSVP: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/failover-preview-officehours. Please post quick repro steps here if you see surprising fallbacks. :pray:
